first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The upright person near the center wearing a light-colored sleeveless top, dark pants, and light-colored shoes, with a light-colored hat, dark long hair beside the shoulders, and a small dark object held in front of the body.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The light-brown quadruped on the Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch to the image-right of Person A, with a low torso and outlines of thin legs beneath the body.

entities.name: Golden Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The broad yellow-brown short grassland covering the foreground and most of the middle ground, interspersed with light-colored bare soil.

entities.name: Mixed Woodland Belt
entities.identification: The woodland at the far end of the grassland, composed of interspersed dark green, tall, pointed crowns and yellow-green to brown-green, broad, rounded crowns.

entities.name: Pale Blue Sky
entities.identification: The pale blue sky area above the woodland, with a smooth tone and no obvious cloud patterns.

entities.name: Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch
entities.identification: The light grayish-yellow, low, flat, irregular-edged sparsely grassed ground patch beneath Person A and Animal A.

entities.name: Open-Sided Shed
entities.identification: The shed at the woodland edge behind and to the image-left of Person A, with a brown-gray gable roof, thin supports, and open space beneath the shed.

entities.name: Open-Sided Shed with a Gray Roof
entities.identification: Another shed partially visible from the left boundary in the final segment, with a light gray sloping roof surface and a small number of thin supports beneath it visible.
